ko: 주 안에 있는 나에게 딴 근심 있으랴
십자가 밑에 나아가 내 짐을 풀었네
en: The trusting heart to Jesus clings, Nor any ill forebodes But at the cross of Calv'ry sings, Praise God for lifted loads

ko: 내 앞길 멀고 험해도 나 주님만 따라가리
en: Singing I go along life's Lord Praising the Lord, praising the Lord Singing I go along life's Lord
For Jesus has lifted my load

ko: 그 두려움이 변하여 내 기도 되었고
전날에 한숨 변하여 내 노래 되었네
en: The passing days bring many cares "Fear not" I hear Him say And when my fears are turned to prayers, The burdens slip away

ko: 내 앞길 멀고 험해도 나 주님만 따라가리
en: Singing I go along life's Lord Praising the Lord, praising the Lord Singing I go along life's Lord
For Jesus has lifted my load

ko: 내 주는 자비하셔서 늘 함께 계시고
내 궁핍함을 아시고 늘 채워 주시네
en: He tells me of my Father's love, And never slumb'ring eye My everlasting King above will all my needs supply

ko: 내 앞길 멀고 험해도 나 주님만 따라가리
en: Singing I go along life's Lord Praising the Lord, praising the Lord Singing I go along life's Lord
For Jesus has lifted my load

ko: 내 주와 맺은 언약은 영 불변하시니
en: When to the throne of grace I flee, I find the promise true The mighty arms upholding me will bear my burdens too
